Attached: 1 image

The AI era isn't only scary. Paired with open source, it gives people like me power we never had.

I'm a product person, not a coder. In Joplin, notebooks and notes ate two whole sidebars, and my urgent tasks drowned in the long list. With an AI agent I forked an MIT-licensed plugin into Cockpit — one panel, every note and to-do grouped by due date. Fork to the official registry: three days.

Open source gave us the right; AI gave us the ability.

https://pmslava.com/posts/open-source-right-ai-ability/

#OpenSource #AI #Joplin
